description:
A newly appointed site supervisor is particularly rude to a female heavy equipment operator. Despite this obvious trick, the men on site defend the driver. In reality, the driver is a seasoned veteran, respected by the men, and a powerful figure on the site. The supervisor, seeking to gain their approval but instead incurring their wrath, becomes even more ashamed and wants to kick the driver out. While everyone else is away for an after-work party, he corners the driver and, when they're alone, crosses the line by engaging in sexual contact. He stages a situation bordering on attempted rape, thinking he's won, but then realizes something is amiss...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
